_note: Matches the Skills prototype (sections-prototype.html 'into the map') and Home §5. `competencies` are the five map shapes (camera/stop order = the `stops` list); each tool is one receipt (name · did · evidence). `crossings` are the four shared tools in the overlaps (S3, ONNX, k6, GitHub Actions) — each names its two shapes in `between` and is written in neither shape's own tool list. `toolbox` = the 'Also in the toolbox' tail. Evidence hrefs are pinned to real routes/URLs; labels match the prototype.
title: Skills
cardHint: a link under any tool to see the evidence

competencies.name: Keeping data honest
competencies.line: Nothing reaches a model before it has a version and a check.

tools.name: DVC
tools.did: Versions the dataset out of Git and into the one S3 bucket.

tools.name: Pandera
tools.did: Checks the data schema before the data can reach training.

competencies.name: Training models
competencies.line: A model has to beat the last one before it can ship.

tools.name: PyTorch
tools.did: Trains the QuickDraw CNN that guesses your drawing on Home.

tools.name: scikit-learn
tools.did: Gives the baseline that the CNN must beat.

tools.name: Python
tools.did: Every pipeline step, from the data checks to the quality gate.

competencies.name: Shipping it
competencies.line: From a trained file to a live address, and back down to zero.

tools.name: Docker
tools.did: Packs the model and its server into one image.

tools.name: AWS Lambda
tools.did: Serves the model, and scales to zero between visitors.

tools.name: Terraform
tools.did: Builds the weekly EKS cluster and tears it down again.

competencies.name: Watching it run
competencies.line: Proof that the model still works after it ships.

tools.name: MLflow
tools.did: Records every run. The registry promotes the winner.

tools.name: Evidently
tools.did: Compares this week's predictions with the training data.

tools.name: Grafana
tools.did: Keeps the load-test dashboards as evidence.

competencies.name: Building the front
competencies.line: The page you are reading, and the demo on it.

tools.name: Next.js
tools.did: This site: a static export that calls the live model.

tools.name: TypeScript
tools.did: Types the data contracts that the Data pages read.

crossings.name: S3
crossings.line: One bucket holds the data, the models, and the evidence.

crossings.name: ONNX
crossings.line: The model leaves PyTorch as ONNX, so a cold start stays short.

crossings.name: k6
crossings.line: Puts load on the live model each month and records the result.

crossings.name: GitHub Actions
crossings.line: Retrains on each model change, and deploys this site.
